subject: The 2AM mistake that changed everything
preview_text: I built something at 2AM that I almost deleted. It ended up changing how I see every match.
body_paragraphs: I don't usually write emails like this. But at 2AM last Tuesday, I made a mistake that ended up giving me the clearest prediction I've ever seen—one that beat every tipster I follow.

I was staring at a data dump for Bayer Leverkusen vs. RB Leipzig, exhausted, about to close the app. Instead, I clicked on the AI Chat out of frustration and typed: 'Who actually wins this if you ignore the hype?' The response stopped me cold. It flagged a defensive weakness no one was talking about—and the AI's confidence score was 68%. I took that bet. It won.
